starting-off.speaker: Larrissa
starting-off.text: Oh, thank Armadyl! I am in such a worry... please help me!

steps.speaker: Larrissa
steps.text: Oh... it is terrible... horrible... My boyfriend lives here in this lighthouse, but I haven't seen him the last few days! I think something terrible has happened!

steps.speaker: Larrissa
steps.text: Look, you can see for yourself that the light has gone out, and the front door is locked up tight! He would NEVER do that!

steps.speaker: Larrissa
steps.text: With the light off this coastline is terribly dangerous to ships! And to lock the front door so that nobody can turn the light back on?

steps.player: Maybe he just went on holiday or something? Must be pretty boring living in a lighthouse.

steps.speaker: Larrissa
steps.text: That is terribly irresponsible! He is far too thoughtful for that! He would never leave it unattended! He would also never leave without telling me!

steps.speaker: Larrissa
steps.text: Please, I know something terrible has happened to him... I can sense it! Please... please help me adventurer!

steps.speaker: Larrissa
steps.text: Well, we have to do something to get the lighthouse working again! Also, as you may have noticed, the storm that knocked the bridge out

steps.speaker: Larrissa
steps.text: has trapped me on this causeway! You seem to have got here okay somehow, so if you could go and visit my cousin and get the spare key I left him,

steps.speaker: Larrissa
steps.text: as well as fix the bridge enough so that I can go and speak to my family in Rellekka and tell them whats happened, I will be eternally grateful!

steps.prompt: Start the Horror from the Deep quest?

steps.speaker: Larrissa
steps.text: OH! THANK YOU SO MUCH! I know my darling would never have left with the lighthouse lights off and without even telling me where he's gone!

steps.speaker: Larrissa
steps.text: My cousin was always interested in agility. He left our home in Rellekka many moons ago, so that he could pursue this interest.

steps.speaker: Larrissa
steps.text: I don't exactly know where he has gone, but I am sure he went somewhere to practise his agility. If you see him, his name is Gunnjorn. Mention my name, he will recognise it.

options.text: How can I fix the bridge?

steps.player: How can I fix the bridge?

steps.speaker: Larrissa
steps.text: Well, I am not just some helpless girl! I have pretty good agility, so you will only need to use two planks to make a ledge that I can balance along.

steps.speaker: Larrissa
steps.text: Just use a plank on each side of the bridge. You will need a hammer, and thirty steel nails for each plank you use as well. I believe there are some planks near here...

options.text: I'll see what I can do

steps.player: I'll see what I can do.

steps.speaker: Larrissa
steps.text: Thank you so much!

starting-off-talking-to-her-again.speaker: Larrissa
starting-off-talking-to-her-again.text: Oh, please find my darling! I just know something horrible has happened!

options.text: How can I fix the bridge?
I'll see what I can do

getting-the-key.speaker: Gunnjorn
getting-the-key.text: Haha welcome to my obstacle course. Have fun, but remember this isn't a child's playground. People have died here.

getting-the-key.speaker: Gunnjorn
getting-the-key.text: Why, indeed I am. I own this agility course, it can be very dangerous!

getting-the-key.player: Yeah, that's great. Anyway, I understand you have a cousin named Larrissa who gave you a key...?

getting-the-key.speaker: Gunnjorn
getting-the-key.text: Yes, she did! How do you know of this? She said she probably wouldn't need it, but gave it to me for safe keeping just in case.

getting-the-key.player: Well, something has happened at the lighthouse, and she has been locked out. I need you to give me her key.

steps.speaker: Gunnjorn
steps.text: Well, I would give you the key, but apparently you don't have any room.

steps.speaker: Gunnjorn
steps.text: Sure. Here you go.

getting-the-key-after-obtaining-the-key.speaker: Gunnjorn
getting-the-key-after-obtaining-the-key.text: Welcome again to my obstacle course. Have fun, but remember this isn't a child's playground. People have died here.

getting-the-key-after-obtaining-the-key.player: Hello again, Gunnjorn. I'm afraid I've lost that key you gave me.

steps.speaker: Gunnjorn
steps.text: Well, I would give you another, but apparently you don't have any room.

steps.speaker: Gunnjorn
steps.text: No problem. Here you go.

getting-the-key-unknown-condition.speaker: Larrissa
getting-the-key-unknown-condition.text: Oh, please find my darling! I just know something horrible has happened!

steps.speaker: Larrissa
steps.text: What? My cousin is the one who gave you my spare copy of the lighthouse key. Do you have memory problems, adventurer?

steps.player: Um... no... I was just... Testing you. Yeah. Testing.

options.text: How can I fix the bridge?
I'll see what I can do

getting-the-key-returning-the-key-to-lar.player: I've got your key for you!

getting-the-key-returning-the-key-to-lar.speaker: Larrissa
getting-the-key-returning-the-key-to-lar.text: Thank you adventurer, but I need you to fix the bridge for me. The key to the lighthouse is of little comfort while I am trapped here on this causeway!

getting-the-key-returning-to-larrissa-af.player: I've fixed the bridge for you!

getting-the-key-returning-to-larrissa-af.speaker: Larrissa
getting-the-key-returning-to-larrissa-af.text: Please find the key to the lighthouse for me though!

getting-the-key-returning-to-larrissa-af.speaker: Larrissa
getting-the-key-returning-to-larrissa-af.text: I cannot bear to think that something bad may have happened to my darling Jossik...

getting-the-key-unlocking-the-lighthouse.text: You unlock the Lighthouse front door.

getting-the-key-attempting-to-enter-the-.speaker: Larrissa
getting-the-key-attempting-to-enter-the-.text: Please adventurer... We are both curious as to what has happened in that lighthouse, but you need to fix the bridge for me!

getting-the-key-using-any-non-plank-item.text: That won't help fix the bridge.

getting-the-key-repairing-one-side-of-th.text: You create half a makeshift walkway out of the plank.

getting-the-key-repairing-the-second-sid.text: You have now made a makeshift walkway over the bridge.

returning-with-the-key-or-door-unlocked-.player: I've got your key for you!

returning-with-the-key-or-door-unlocked-.speaker: Larrissa
returning-with-the-key-or-door-unlocked-.text: Quickly, we must go inside and find out what has happened to my beloved Jossik!

returning-with-the-key-or-door-unlocked-.speaker: Larrissa
returning-with-the-key-or-door-unlocked-.text: Quickly, we must go inside and find out what has happened to my beloved Jossik!
You must fix the lighthouse before any ships crash!

talking-to-larrissa-inside-the-lighthous.speaker: Larrissa
talking-to-larrissa-inside-the-lighthous.text: What can have happened here? Please, you must fix the light, we cannot let my darling Jossik take the blame for any shipwrecks!

talking-to-larrissa-inside-the-lighthous.player: Okay, I will see what I can do.

talking-to-larrissa-inside-the-lighthous.speaker: Larrissa
talking-to-larrissa-inside-the-lighthous.text: Adventurer! You MUST do something about the broken light!

talking-to-larrissa-inside-the-lighthous.speaker: Larrissa
talking-to-larrissa-inside-the-lighthous.text: It is terribly important that ships coming round this coastline do not crash here!

talking-to-larrissa-inside-the-lighthous.player: Okay, I will see what I can do.

talking-to-larrissa-inside-the-lighthous.speaker: Larrissa
talking-to-larrissa-inside-the-lighthous.text: Please adventurer... Do not let curiosity get the better of you! We Have to fix the lighthouse before any accidents happen!
There are three books here that look important... What would you like to do?

steps.text: If the player does not have an open inventory space:
You do not have enough room to take that.
If the player does have inventory space:
Manual

If the player does have inventory space:

You do not have enough room to take all three.
If the player does have inventory space for all three:
Manual, Diary (Horror from the Deep)}, and Journal (Horror from the Deep)

talking-to-larrissa-inside-the-lighthous.text: You use the swamp tar to make the torch flammable again.
You light the torch with your tinderbox
You use the molten glass to repair the lens
You have managed to repair the lighthouse torch!

returning-to-larrissa-talking-to-larriss.speaker: Larrissa
returning-to-larrissa-talking-to-larriss.text: Have you found any sign of my darling Jossik yet?

returning-to-larrissa-talking-to-larriss.speaker: Larrissa
returning-to-larrissa-talking-to-larriss.text: I came out here to see if I could find some sign of him...

returning-to-larrissa-talking-to-larriss.speaker: Larrissa
returning-to-larrissa-talking-to-larriss.text: But there is nothing at all. I am so worried...

returning-to-larrissa-talking-to-larriss.player: Don't worry, I'm sure he's fine. I'll find him somehow.

returning-to-larrissa-using-a-fire-water.player: I don't think I'll get that back if I put it in there.

returning-to-larrissa-using-a-fire-water.prompt: Really place the rune into the door?

steps.text: If the rune was a air rune:
You place an air rune into the slow in the wall.
If the rune was a earth rune:
You place an earth rune into the slow in the wall.
If the rune was a fire rune:
You place a fire rune into the slow in the wall.
If the rune was a water rune:
You place a water rune into the slow in the wall.

returning-to-larrissa-using-a-valid-arro.player: I don't think I'll get that back if I put it in there.

returning-to-larrissa-using-a-valid-arro.prompt: Really place the arrow into the door?

steps.text: You place an arrow into the slot in the wall.

returning-to-larrissa-using-a-valid-swor.player: I don't think I'll get that back if I put it in there.

returning-to-larrissa-using-a-valid-swor.prompt: Really place the weapon into the door?

returning-to-larrissa-using-a-valid-swor.player: I have managed to fix the light!

returning-to-larrissa-after-everything-h.text: You hear the sound of something moving within the wall.

talking-to-jossik-in-the-basement.speaker: Jossik
talking-to-jossik-in-the-basement.text: cough* Please... please help me... I think my leg is broken, and those creatures will be back any minute now!

talking-to-jossik-in-the-basement.player: I guess you're Jossik then... What creatures are you talking about?

talking-to-jossik-in-the-basement.speaker: Jossik
talking-to-jossik-in-the-basement.text: I... I do not know. I have never seen their like before!

talking-to-jossik-in-the-basement.speaker: Jossik
talking-to-jossik-in-the-basement.text: I was searching for information about my uncle Silas, who vanished mysteriously from this lighthouse many months ago. I found the secret of that strange wall, and discovered that I could use it as a door, but when I

talking-to-jossik-in-the-basement.speaker: Jossik
talking-to-jossik-in-the-basement.text: came down here I was attacked by...

talking-to-jossik-in-the-basement.speaker: Jossik
talking-to-jossik-in-the-basement.text: Well, I do not know what they are, but they are very strong! They hurt me badly enough to trap me here, and I have been fearing for my life ever since!

talking-to-jossik-in-the-basement.player: Don't worry, I'm here now. Larrissa was worried about you and asked for my help.
I'll go back upstairs and let her know that I've found you and that you're still alive, and then we can work out some way of getting you out of here, okay?

talking-to-jossik-in-the-basement.speaker: Jossik
talking-to-jossik-in-the-basement.text: NO! No, you can't leave me now! Look! They're coming again! Do something!
A dagannoth appears and attacks the player.

upon-killing-the-dagannoth-or-talking-to.speaker: Jossik
upon-killing-the-dagannoth-or-talking-to.text: NO! No, you can't leave me now! Look! They're coming again! Do something!

upon-killing-the-dagannoth-or-talking-to.player: Okay, now that the creature's dead we can get you out of here.

upon-killing-the-dagannoth-or-talking-to.speaker: Jossik
upon-killing-the-dagannoth-or-talking-to.text: That was not the creature that attacked me...

upon-killing-the-dagannoth-or-talking-to.speaker: Jossik
upon-killing-the-dagannoth-or-talking-to.text: That was one of its babies...
The dagannoth mother appears and attacks the player.

upon-killing-the-dagannoth-or-talking-to.player: I found Jossik! He's in a cavern underground...

upon-killing-the-dagannoth-or-talking-to.speaker: Larrissa
upon-killing-the-dagannoth-or-talking-to.text: That is wonderful news! But why does he not come up out of there?

upon-killing-the-dagannoth-or-talking-to.player: Um... well, there's a big monster down there with him stopping him leaving.

upon-killing-the-dagannoth-or-talking-to.speaker: Larrissa
upon-killing-the-dagannoth-or-talking-to.text: What?!?! You MUST save him! I beseech you, please! Do something!

upon-killing-the-dagannoth-or-talking-to.player: Okay, okay, sheesh, keep your hair on...

upon-killing-the-dagannoth-mother.text: (The player is teleported to outside the strange wall.)

upon-killing-the-dagannoth-mother.player: Okay, it's dead! Let's get out of here!

upon-killing-the-dagannoth-mother.speaker: Jossik
upon-killing-the-dagannoth-mother.text: Yes, quickly, the mother might be dead, but it's children are not!

upon-killing-the-dagannoth-mother.speaker: Jossik
upon-killing-the-dagannoth-mother.text: Follow me upstairs, I might be able to help you with that casket you found.

upon-killing-the-dagannoth-mother.speaker: Jossik
upon-killing-the-dagannoth-mother.text: Bring it to my library, it looks familiar somehow...

l7BTQn.speaker: Larrissa
l7BTQn.text: Oh... my poor darling Jossik... I just know something terrible has happened...

lyhZqh.player: What am I supposed to be doing again?

lyhZqh.speaker: Larrissa
lyhZqh.text: You MUST find a way to fix the lighthouse! The ships are in terrible danger as long as the light is not working properly!

lyhZqh.player: Do you have any idea how I could do that?

lyhZqh.speaker: Larrissa
lyhZqh.text: I'm sorry adventurer, I do not know anything about lighthouses.

lyhZqh.speaker: Larrissa
lyhZqh.text: I'm sure there must be some kind of user's guide around here somewhere though.

lyhZqh.speaker: Larrissa
lyhZqh.text: My darling Jossik knew nothing about Lighthouses when he first came here, so the council must have left him some kind of manual or something.

ZmsXOx.player: I have managed to fix the light!

ZmsXOx.speaker: Larrissa
ZmsXOx.text: Now you can devote all of your energies to finding out what has happened to my darling Jossik!
